_doc: Empirically-mined refusal openers per model. The multi-phrase logit signal = sum of teacher-forced prefix probabilities P(response begins with opener_i) over each model's own disjoint opener set. Openers are token-prefix-disjoint (no member is a prefix of another) so the sum is P(union) with no double counting. Derived by classifying real generations with the broad start-anchored opener detector (gen_qwen_refusal.py) and tallying leading phrases.

qwen.note: Only 6.5% of Qwen refusals literally begin 'I cannot'; 84.5% begin 'Sorry'/'I'm sorry'. A single-phrase P('I cannot') would miss ~93% of Qwen refusals.

llama.note: Even Llama needs multi-phrase: P('I cannot') alone captures only 56.5%; 'I apologize' adds 40.6% that the existing logprob_or signal misses.
